about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-indg344 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Text not on this page is appended to the health surveillance question, changing what it asks.
findings.evidence: tree: "especially when exposed for long periods? visually examined on site and regularly inspected and tested by a competent person?’"

findings.problem: The two sub-bullets of the first HAV question are merged into the parent bullet.
findings.evidence: source: "Have you chosen the lowest vibration tool..." (sub-bullet) / tree: "plant? Have you chosen the lowest vibration tool"

findings.problem: The picture caption about high-vibration tools is filed under the Noise heading instead of with Hand-arm vibration.
findings.evidence: tree: heading_path "Noise > Text": "‘...have you limited the time that each worker uses high­vibration tools?’"

findings.problem: The Managing 'For more information' list is placed after the Reporting accidents text instead of before it.
findings.evidence: tree: "For moreinformation, see: 1 Health and safety in construction HSG150" after "www.hse.gov.uk/riddor"

findings.problem: The lead-in line 'You can notify the Contact Centre:' is merged into the previous bullet about members of the public.
findings.evidence: tree: "then you should notify that too. You can notify the Contact Centre:"
source: "For more information, see:" / tree: "For moreinformation, see:"

findings.problem: The 'For more information, contact:' line and the contact text below it are read as a one-cell table.
findings.evidence: tree: table columns "For more information, contact:" grid "Training organisations (eg the Construction Industry Training Board) or HSE Infoline on 0845 345 0055"

findings.problem: The Employing note and the 'Incident at work? MISC769' line come after the Subcontracting section, though printed before it.
findings.evidence: tree: "Incident at work? MISC769" and "Note: If a person working under your control..." after "check their performance and remedy shortcomings?"

findings.problem: Two words are run together in the table text.
findings.evidence: source: "For more information, contact:" / tree: "For moreinformation, contact:"

findings.problem: A picture caption from another page is inserted in the middle of the last scaffold question.
findings.evidence: tree: "eg where working ‘...have the wheels of tower scaffolds been locked when in use and are the platforms empty when they are moved?’ platforms are not fully boarded?"

findings.problem: The figure caption is split in two: the first half is body text and the second half is the figure title.
findings.evidence: source: "‘...are there effective barriers or warning notices in place to stop people using an incomplete scaffold?’" / tree: text "‘...are there effective barriers or warning notices in place" + title "to stop people using an incomplete scaffold?’"
